service.description: An m-chart for a report (style-guide §3.12 and §5.1): config, the :config expression to put in a single-quoted attribute (already escaped for it), html the m-chart element with it, and tui, the terminal's chart component (a map for ${JSON.stringify(...)} in a tui text). type bar or line; labels the x values; series [{name, data, kind (bar or line, for a mixed chart), dashed, axis (y or y2)}]; stacked bars; horizontal bars (indexAxis y); percent for a y axis in percent; yTitle and y2Title; height (default 260px). Series take primary, secondary, accent, info, warning, positive and negative in order, then the darker blue, teal, purple, orange and green; the text and grid colors follow the page's theme. A chart never carries meaning by color alone: the legend names each series, and each report has its table.

The options of the reports' parameters among what the user sees: projectOptions (the projects the user sees, not templates; with includeClosed the closed ones too), programOptions (projects with sub-projects), clientOptions (the current Customer and CustomerBillTo of those projects), managerOptions (their ProjectManager and Manager parties), personOptions (their internal members), workTypeOptions (the WorkType enumerations), typeOptions (the work item types, WorkEffortPurpose of tasks), each [{value, label}] by label; managesMoney (ADMIN or TIME_ENTRY_RATE).
